harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /swapfile as an exact 512 MiB, root-owned mode-0600 swap file. It is active immediately, persisted in /etc/fstab, and automatically recovered after node1 rebooted. Boot ID changed from bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5 to d3c6ff37-d2e9-4060-8cf0-e506be6193e6; the system returned to running with no failed units.
actions_performed: Created and initialized /swapfile with an exact file size of 536870912 bytes.
Activated /swapfile and added `/swapfile swap swap defaults 0 0` to /etc/fstab.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the swap file, signature, fstab entry, active swap unit, and system health after reboot.

evidence.requirement: 512 MiB swap file is configured and active now
evidence.summary: Shows exact 536870912-byte size, mode 0600, root ownership, swap signature, persistent fstab entry, and live activation in /proc/swaps.

evidence.requirement: Swap file remains active after future boots
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy pre-restart configuration, reboot request, changed boot ID, and post-restart active swapfile.swap unit with intact file, signature, and fstab entry.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID was bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5. The reboot command disconnected as the restart began. The recovered node reported boot ID d3c6ff37-d2e9-4060-8cf0-e506be6193e6, system state running, active swap, and no failed units.
